messages:
amy (Docs): Morning — need quick ack on PR #5231. It's the v0.9.3 migration guide + SDK snippet updates. Targeting release tomorrow 10:00 PT. Can reviewers merge after CI green?

raj (Eng): I'll take a look, aiming today EOD. Anything behind a feature flag?

amy (Docs): Yes — feature flag is `new-embed-api`. Docs should stay gated until it's enabled in staging. Also we need the versioned pages under /v0.9/ updated.

docs-bot: Preview for PR 5231 available: https://preview.redwood.dev/pr-5231 (build 197). Status: checks pending.

maria (PM): Heads up — release cutoff is 09:00 PT tomorrow. If docs aren't merged by then we ship without them (and we'll need a follow-up hotfix).

sam (Release): If CI is flaky we can do a post-release patch, but prefer merge before cutoff. Can we coordinate a short merge window 08:30-08:45 PT with a deployer oncall?

dena (DevEx): I can be oncall for docs preview at 08:30. If we need to force-merge after green checks, I'll run final sanity checks on the rendered pages.

raj (Eng): Found a minor SDK snippet bug — missing the `timeout` param in the example. Pushing a fix now. Docs lint catches it so should unblock CI.

amy (Docs): Thanks. I also fixed two internal links in the PR description (embed guide + vocab table). Updated the PR body with notes.

docs-bot: CI update: build 197 — running tests.

docs-bot: CI passed for build 197. Docs preview (rendered): https://preview.redwood.dev/pr-5231. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.dev/preview/5231.png

maria (PM): Confirming: we prefer docs merged before cutoff. Release tag will reference the docs commit hash if merged.

sam (Release): Ok schedule proposal: 08:30 PT quick review -> 08:40 PT merge -> 09:00 PT tag + release. @dena can you be ready at 08:30 to validate preview?

dena (DevEx): Yep, I'll be there.

amy (Docs): Plan: if anything blocks at 08:30 (CI flakes), docs team will approve, and @sam will coordinate a manual merge once CI stabilizes. Avoid force-merge unless critical.

raj (Eng): LGTM after my commit. @amy please merge when green.

amy (Docs): Merging as soon as docs-bot reports green.

docs-bot: PR 5231 — all checks green. Ready to merge.

amy (Docs): Merged PR #5231 — commit abc1234. (Thanks team) :tada:

docs-bot: PR 5231 merged by amy (Docs) — commit abc1234. Preview removed.

sam (Release): Release tagging started. Will include docs commit abc1234.

maria (PM): Awesome, thanks everyone.

raj (Eng): Nice — quick turn.

dena (DevEx): If any post-release doc fixes pop up, we can do a hotfix branch and backport to /v0.9/.
